text: Nothing the Board shares with the Vendor about pending tenders may be passed on to anyone outside the project team.
label: confidentiality

text: Staff of the Contractor must keep to themselves whatever they learn about applicants while processing their files.
label: confidentiality

text: Copies of internal memos handed over for this assignment shall be kept under lock and shown to no outsider.
label: confidentiality

text: The Authority may bring this arrangement to a close at any time by writing to the Contractor one month in advance.
label: termination

text: If the Vendor stops providing the service for more than ten working days, the Department may walk away from this contract.
label: termination

text: This lease lapses on the last day of March unless both sides sign an extension.
label: termination

text: Should any citizen sue the Office because of a mistake by the Vendor's staff, the Vendor shall bear every rupee of the resulting cost.
label: indemnification

text: The Contractor will step in and cover the Municipality for any claim arising from accidents at the work site.
label: indemnification

text: Any fine levied on the Agency because of the Supplier's breach of labour rules shall be borne by the Supplier.
label: indemnification

text: The Office will transfer the agreed amount to the Vendor's account within a month of each approved bill.
label: payment

text: Ten percent of every running bill shall be withheld until the work passes final inspection.
label: payment

text: The consultant's charges for each quarter are due on the first working day of that quarter.
label: payment

text: Any disagreement that the parties cannot settle by talking shall be decided by a single arbitrator sitting in Mysuru.
label: governing_law

text: Only the High Court of Karnataka may hear proceedings arising under this agreement.
label: governing_law

text: This contract is to be read and enforced according to Indian statutes.
label: governing_law

text: Whatever goes wrong, the Vendor will never owe the Office more than the amount it was paid in the past year.
label: limitation_of_liability

text: The Department is not answerable for lost profits or missed business opportunities of the Contractor.
label: limitation_of_liability

text: The Office's responsibility for corrupted files extends only to restoring them from the latest backup.
label: limitation_of_liability
